# Ahmed Alvee

> Solutions architect building AI and automation that clinics and teams actually use. MBA candidate at Rotterdam School of Management (2026 to 2027). AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Associate.

This page has an AI agent ("Ask my agent") that answers questions about Ahmed's work from his CV and notes.

## Results

- Clinic onboarding: 3 to 5 days down to under 1, rebuilt on AWS.
- Lab and radiology batch turnaround: 1 week down to 1 day.
- Data clean-up per submission: 1 hour down to 6 to 10 minutes, with an AI pipeline (LangGraph, Claude via Amazon Bedrock) for 30+ clinics.

## Experience

- Solutions Architect, Mesh Bio, Singapore (05/2022 to 12/2025, previously Senior Solutions Engineer). Redesigned client onboarding on AWS (Lambda, SNS, SQS, Step Functions, HL7). Built the lab and radiology data pipeline. Architected an AI clean-up pipeline for 30+ clinics. Led on-site deployment for the first overseas customer. Hired and led 2 to 3 solutions engineers.
- AI Strategy Consultant, RSM Living Management Project, client Truvalu, Rotterdam (06/2026 to 07/2026). Designed a 5-stage AI monitoring workflow for an impact investor, projected to cut monitoring time by about 45%.
- Software Engineer, Creative Medtech Solutions, Singapore (09/2021 to 04/2022). Imaging annotation and interaction layer for a HIFU cancer-ablation robot, including DICOM export.
- Research Assistant, Singapore University of Technology and Design (02/2018 to 08/2021). Locomotion code for a 12+ robot mapping system. ML pipeline recognizing 7 hand gestures.
